facts.fact: Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 16.7 per cent of tertiary graduates in Ghana in 2021, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 14.3 per cent of tertiary graduates in Ghana in 2022, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 16.6 per cent of tertiary graduates in Ghana in 2023, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 18.7 per cent of tertiary graduates in Ghana in 2024, by UNESCO's series.
